title: Lohe Ke Haath
desc: Gayatri's mother-in-law Bindu Devi tries to set fire to her on her wedding night for her dowry; her husband Jainath is equally responsible for this attempt. Gayatri is saved by Triloki, but he doesn't have good intentions: he rapes her. Gayatri saves another woman from getting molested and both meet Maataji, who is also a victim of dowry. Maataji trains helpless women to fight against injustice and Gayatri turns into a rebel.

title: Aadmi
desc: Vijay, a factory supervisor, is falsely accused and arrested for killing his family. Just when he is at his lowest point, an inspector offers to help him in return for capturing the son of a gangster.

title: Patthar Ke Phool
desc: A young lady having grown up in a household full of love and admiration, Suraj is now a young adult who had no idea her father has been part of a dangerous mafia; she eventually falls in love with a police officer.

title: Rakhwale
desc: A Young man who is framed for a murder which he has not committed. He is sentenced to life imprisonment but escapes from jail to prove his innocence. Along the way in his mission he is helped by many individual.

title: Suhana Safar
desc: Enticed by his poetry, Sapna travels to India from the USA to meet poet Ujjwala. She meets a man, Sunil, who falls for her but decides to help her reach him in Phulwari.
